Restaurant's favorite review
Hidden Bar with Spectacular Sunset View
Sep 2026 • Business
Never expect a view like this. A new sky bar in city center with magical sunset. Though it feels hot and humid at first, the breeze has become so valuable for open space, as we are mostly in air conditioned environment. Located at level 23 next to meeting, it is very convenient to sip a quick cocktail and have few snacks before the dinner. Watching whole buildings within the backdrop of sunsets really ease the mind.
Service team is young and cute. Love their energy. Food is good, esp "chả giò", the must try item.
After 6, the bartender served a signature cocktail of the day with trolly around. He is very passionate which impressed us a lot, for such a connection.

Insider tip:
Access from the Sheraton Saigon lobby as it is inside the hotel

A cozy spot above the city
Sep 2026 • Solo
I’ve been to Sheraton Saigon a few times and recently came back to check out Hai Bar after the recent renovation.

The bar is quite small, but I actually like the cozy and chill atmosphere. I tried the Shiso Leaf cocktail and really enjoyed it, fresh and nicely balanced.

The staff were friendly and professional as always. Since the bar is on a high floor, the city view is definitely a plus. It’s also a nice spot to watch what’s happening around the city, and I can imagine it being a great place to catch the fireworks.

BEST STORYTELLING COCKTAILS
Aug 2026 • Friends
Honestly one of my fav bar experiences in Vietnam. 🍸

Austin, the manager, literally took me on a cocktail journey through North, Central & South Vietnam. Every drink had its own Vietnamese ingredients + story, and his enthusiasm was so contagious I just went along for the ride.

Felt like I traveled through Vietnam without leaving the bar 😂 10/10, definitely let Austin choose your drinks!

Jun 2026 • Friends

The panoramic view is unbeatable, offering a stunning 270-degree skyline view of Saigon District 1.

The food and drinks are excellent value for money, and the service provided by the staff is genuinely five-star.

I highly recommend visiting during sunset and staying until the evening. It was a very memorable experience
